nativeFormat.input: Original admitted GTFS ZIP with root UTF-8 comma-separated text members; stored or deflated ZIP
nativeFormat.identity: Publisher + source/feed namespace + native table + native ID; service IDs shared across calendar/calendar_dates within that feed. Labels and downloaded byte hashes never replace feed-native IDs. Optional single agency without agency_id is an explicitly row-located source mention, not a fabricated agency identifier.
nativeFormat.dates: YYYYMMDD validated and mapped to ISO date, original lexeme retained. Service validity and exception dates are distinct from retrieval/publication. GTFS HH:MM:SS is a service-day time and may exceed 24 hours; timezone remains agency_timezone, not inferred UTC.
nativeFormat.units: Stop coordinates in WGS84 degrees; no observed performance metric. Route and exception codes are native codes, not measurements.
nativeFormat.schemaChange: Missing required columns, invalid dates, broken references or ambiguous keys produce atomic held_quality. Additional columns/members are recorded as unmapped limitations, not silently promoted to facts.
nativeFormat.withdrawal: calendar_dates exception_type 2 removes scheduled service on the sourced date; not actual service cancellation or trip/agency deletion. Missing landing links and header-only feeds are not tombstones.
relations: Route scheduled_serves Stop through trip/stop_times native references
Stop located_in Municipality only from evidenced spatial join
nativeFormat.evidence: Primary evidence retains the original ZIP SHA256, member/table, source row, raw field lexeme, native key, header schema hash and mapping version; no fabricated prose/model/judge receipts. Spatial joins bind separately admitted native GeoJSON bytes and feature locator in supportingEvidence with role municipality_join; external boundary hashes never enter primary GTFS evidence. Parent admission must additionally bind the original boundary policy/CAS proofs.

geographicJoin.requiredInput: Optional separately admitted native RFC7946 FeatureCollection; Polygon/MultiPolygon features with string properties.ags and explicit properties.boundary_vintage
geographicJoin.method: WGS84 point-in-polygon with holes; exactly one matching polygon, excluding edges and overlap ambiguity
geographicJoin.scope: Only the requested pilot AGS can be assigned; all other records remain geographically unknown
geographicJoin.withoutBoundaries: Native stops retained, AGS null/basis unknown. No town service-completeness claim.
geographicJoin.vintage: Explicit source boundary_vintage preserved in evidence-backed join limitations; no fabricated boundary-currentness claim

bounds.sharedNativeParser: Reuses structured-tables.ts readZip/readCsv with explicit GTFS limits above (CSV row bound includes one header). Default workbook limits remain unchanged. Oversized original feeds hold_quality atomically rather than truncate or claim complete coverage.
bounds.execution: Pure in-memory parser, no network/subprocess/filesystem extraction; shared isolated parser job boundary still required by executor
